about: Nine original Christmas songs celebrating our family's funniest gift-giving traditions, homemade surprises, and the people who make the holidays unforgettable.
body: Every family has its own Christmas traditions. In ours, wrapping a gift can turn into an engineering challenge, an ordinary toy horse can return year after year in increasingly elaborate disguises, and the funniest moments are often the ones nobody planned.

These nine original songs preserve the stories behind our holidays: a child's conviction that Rudolph deserves a snack of his own, Christmas at Grandma Lammert's house, Dillon's long-awaited train, outrageous twelve-pocket jeans, and a familiar Christmas horse that eventually becomes a Trojan invasion.

There are barrels, padlocks, hidden clues, power tools, homemade surprises, and plenty of friendly competition over who can devise the most unforgettable gift. Beneath the mischief is something more important: the love, creativity, and determination that keep a family together and make every Christmas worth remembering.
